Need to know the desired look: the progress line — filled portion blue, remaining gray (like screenshot). I'll style:
- track: height 6px, border-radius 3px, no border, background = linear-gradient blue up to thumb, gray after. But dynamic fill via CSS gradient needs the value; simpler: use `background` gradient by percentage updated on input. Alternatively keep it simple: track gray, thumb blue dot, and use `accentColor` won't work with appearance:none.

To preserve the **filled-blue-to-thumb** look from the screenshot, I'll compute the fill percentage and set the track's `background: linear-gradient(to right, #004fd0 0%, #004fd0 {p}%, #dfe3ea {p}%, #dfe3ea 100%)`, updating on input. Let me rewrite the component.

tool_input.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted, watch } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{ modelValue: number; min?: number; max?: number }>()
const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [number] }>()

const uid = 'ref8443-range-style'

function hostEl(): HTMLElement | null {
  // uni-app H5 的 <view ref> 拿不到 DOM，直接查渲染后的宿主节点
  return document.querySelector('.ref8443-range-host') as HTMLElement | null
}

/* 运行时注入滑块样式：去掉原生轨道边框，改为无边框的自绘进度线 + 蓝色圆点 */
function injectStyle() {
  if (document.getElementById(uid)) return
  const style = document.createElement('style')
  style.id = uid
  style.textContent = `
.ref8443-range-host input.range, .ref8443-range-host input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none!important; -moz-appearance:none!important; appearance:none!important;
  width:100%!important; height:16px!important; min-height:16px!important;
  padding:0!important; margin:0!important; border:0!important; outline:none!important;
  background:transparent!important; box-sizing:border-box!important; display:inline-block!important;
  cursor:pointer;
}
/* WebKit 轨道：无边框、圆角 */
.ref8443-range-host input.range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track,
.ref8443-range-host input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{
  height:6px; border:0!important; border-radius:3px; outline:none!important;
  background:transparent;
}
/* WebKit 滑块圆点 */
.ref8443-range-host input.range::-webkit-slider-thumb,
.ref8443-range-host input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none!important; appearance:none!important;
  width:16px; height:16px; margin-top:-5px; border:0!important; border-radius:50%;
  background:#004fd0; box-shadow:none!important; cursor:pointer;
}
/* Firefox 轨道与滑块 */
.ref8443-range-host input.range::-moz-range-track,
.ref8443-range-host input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{
  height:6px; border:0!important; border-radius:3px; background:transparent;
}
.ref8443-range-host input.range::-moz-range-progress,
.ref8443-range-host input[type=range]::-moz-range-progress{
  height:6px; border:0; border-radius:3px; background:#004fd0;
}
.ref8443-range-host input.range::-moz-range-thumb,
.ref8443-range-host input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:16px; height:16px; border:0!important; border-radius:50%; background:#004fd0; cursor:pointer;
}
`
  document.head.appendChild(style)
}

/* 计算填充百分比，给轨道上色（蓝→灰） */
function paint(el: HTMLInputElement) {
  const min = Number(props.min ?? 0)
  const max = Number(props.max ?? 3)
  const v = Number(el.value || min)
  const p = max > min ? ((v - min) / (max - min)) * 100 : 0
  el.style.background = `linear-gradient(to right, #004fd0 0%, #004fd0 ${p}%, #dfe3ea ${p}%, #dfe3ea 100%)`
}

function mountNative() {
  const el = hostEl()
  if (!el) return
  if (el.querySelector('input[type=range]')) {
    paint(el.querySelector('input[type=range]') as HTMLInputElement)
    return
  }
  el.innerHTML = ''
  const input = document.createElement('input')
  input.type = 'range'
  input.className = 'range'
  input.min = String(props.min ?? 0)
  input.max = String(props.max ?? 3)
  input.value = String(props.modelValue)
  // uni H5 编译会把全局 input 选择器改写成 uni-input，故直接内联，确保与 8443 一致
  Object.assign(input.style, {
    width: '100%',
    height: '16px',
    minHeight: '16px',
    padding: '0',
    margin: '0',
    border: '0',
    outline: 'none',
    background: 'transparent',
    accentColor: '#004fd0',
    boxSizing: 'border-box',
    display: 'inline-block',
  })
  paint(input)
  input.addEventListener('input', () => {
    paint(input)
    emit('update:modelValue', Number(input.value))
  })
  el.appendChild(input)
}

onMounted(() => {
  injectStyle()
  mountNative()
  // H5 渲染时序兜底
  setTimeout(mountNative, 50)
  setTimeout(mountNative, 300)
})

watch(() => props.modelValue, (v) => {
  const input = hostEl()?.querySelector('input[type=range]') as HTMLInputElement | null
  if (input && Number(input.value) !== v) {
    input.value = String(v)
    paint(input)
  }
})
</script>
<template>
  <view class="ref8443-range-host" />
</template>
